descriptions.build: Changes that affect the build system or external dependencies (example scopes: gulp, broccoli, npm)
descriptions.chore: Changes which don't change source code or tests e.g. changes to the build process, auxiliary tools, libraries
descriptions.ci: Changes to CI configuration files and scripts (example scopes: Travis, Circle, BrowserStack, SauceLabs)
descriptions.perf: A code change that improves performance
descriptions.refactor: A code change that neither fixes a bug nor adds a feature
descriptions.style: Changes that do not affect the meaning of the code (white-space, formatting, missing semi-colons, etc)
descriptions.test: Adding missing tests or correcting existing tests
